text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Christmas... or rather, a little before. 
One winter's day—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Merryyyy Christmas!! ...Or something!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen falling on Christmas 
this year, Inari One and I decided to hold 
our party early, just the two of us...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Well, given the circumstances this year, 
it can't be helped! We should just be glad 
we get to celebrate at all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well now――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Back when I lived in my hometown, there 
were always neighborhood banquets. I used 
to join in every year, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"The old folks, the neighborhood kids, 
everyone gathered around eating and making 
a racket... It felt just like a classic 
winter festival!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"—Ever since I came here, I've ended up 
partying with everyone at the academy. 
There are plenty of folks who throw 
gatherings for all sorts of reasons, too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Besides, every last one of 'em is 
hilarious, partying hard enough to rival 
back home, so I never got bored!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—And this year, I'm celebrating like this 
with you, Boss.
choice_data_list:
Things ended up being a little modest this 
year, huh.

This New Year's turned out to be a little 
low-key, huh

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—And this year, I'm celebrating like this 
with you, Big Sis.
choice_data_list:
Things ended up being a little modest this 
year, huh.

This New Year's turned out to be a little 
low-key, huh

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about?! Like I said 
before, I'm grateful just having you do 
it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Boss went out of his way to 
splurge and treat us to all this delicious 
food, so today is more than enough of a 
festival already!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Big Sis went out of her way to 
splurge and treat us to all this delicious 
food, so today is more than enough of a 
festival already!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, pickin' sushi for Christmas, you 
really do get me. Having inari sushi in 
there is stylish as hell...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come on, the food's gonna get cold, so 
let's get this started! It's our 
Christmas-slash-Arima Kinen victory prayer 
festival, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our Christmas party for two began, 
naturally turning into a time for Inari 
One and me to look back on all we'd 
shared—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While picking at our food, we merrily 
chatted about all the festive ruckus Inari 
One and I had been through from the day we 
met until today..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, is it that time already?! Time 
flies so fast, it's crazy!
choice_data_list:
We have an early start tomorrow too, so 
shall we wrap things up soon?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There's still plenty of final 
touches I wanna get in before the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the days since I met 
Boss have really flown by in the blink of 
an eye, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the days since I met 
Big Sis have really flown by in the blink 
of an eye, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I guess that just shows what a 
blast this brawlin' road trip really was!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, my bad. Didn't mean to go and make 
things so gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Boss. When a festival comes to an 
end, do you know how to get rid of that 
'lonely' feeling?”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Sis. When a festival comes to an 
end, do you know how to get rid of that 
'lonely' feeling?”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's simple. All we gotta do is decide 
when the next festival is!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, you'll naturally look 
forward to the next festival, and all 
those gloomy thoughts will just blow away!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why! Once the Arima Kinen is 
over, let's throw another celebration!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Next up, a victory bash combined with 
Christmas day, and maybe thrown in with 
New Year's too— Haha, this is gonna keep 
us busy!
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, and for that purpose, first—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen—I've gotta make sure I win 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, ahead of the decisive battle, the 
two of us spent a modest yet heartwarming 
Christmas together—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, now that we've decided on 
the next festival—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, Christmas present.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, now that's a great reaction! Well, I 
went and got it on my own, so don't sweat 
it and just take it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Naturally!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon opening the gift, inside was a 
lockable wooden box in a tastefully muted 
color...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The meticulously finished surface has a 
faint luster and feels smooth to the 
touch, and the lid is carved with a 
fox...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—It ain't much, but hey, you can use it to 
hold knick-knacks or whatever! Figured it 
might help tidy up your desk a bit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Guess so. Just a bit of DIY handiwork, 
and it was done in a jiffy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I figured it'd feel kind of hollow without 
a gift. Made it in between training, so it 
really ain't anything fancy, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One says so, but the quality was so 
high that it wouldn't look out of place 
sitting on a store shelf, so I was 
surprised to hear it was handmade...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C-Cut it out. It's just a wooden box, ya 
know? I wish I could've thought of 
something a bit fancier, though—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I pack the familiar tools of my trade 
sitting on the desk, such as my stopwatch 
and pens, into the box.
choice_data_list: Look, this is perfect for storing it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ......Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Looks like I got something real good too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, ahead of the decisive battle, the 
two of us spent a modest yet heartwarming 
Christmas together—
